title: BNT
body:
![with a resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a92d69314380ff785de5f99bd9ceef0b313b61ce.png)

The resource pack ports textures from newer Minecraft versions and snapshots.

OptiFine is optional, but it adds support for additional models, such as the updated redstone torch and the newer horse model.

Some textures were created or edited by me, including the horse textures and horse armor for the version without OptiFine.

The resource pack version matches the Minecraft version the assets were ported from.
